This Petition, Coming On For Orders, This Day,
Order Was Made Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr Justice S.R.Krishna Kumar
 Oral Order

In this petition, petitioner has sought for the following relief:-
"a) Quash the further investigation pending against the Petitioners in Crime No.19/2025 (Shimogga Rural Police Station) for the offences punishable under Section 506, 376 and 417 of IPC pending JMFC III Court at Shimogga, produced at Annexure-A and B, holding that it is an abuse of process of law.
b) Pass appropriate orders under the facts and circumstances of the case, in the interest of justice."
2.

Learned counsel for the petitioner - accused and learned counsel for respondent No.2 - complainant have filed a Joint Affidavit dated 22.05.2025 duly signed by the petitioner, respondent No.2 and their respective counsel and the same is taken on record.

3. Petitioner - accused and his counsel and counsel for respondent No.2-complainant are physically present before the Court and they admit the contents of the Joint Affidavit dated 22.05.2025, which reads as under:-
NC: 2025:KHC:18730 HC-KAR "JOINT AFFIDAVIT "We NAVEEN KUMAR, Aged about 29 years, S/o Revanappa, R/o 2nd Cross, Mallikarjuna Nagara, Honnali Road,
Shimogga 577 204 and Smt. POOJA D/o Papanna, Aged 26 years, Residing at Ambedkar Nagara, Tarikere Taluk, Chickamagaluru District, 577228, do hereby Sri Naveen Kumar vs State Of Karnataka on 3 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146855823/
2 solemnly affirm and state on oath as follows,
1.

entities.text: Sri Naveen Kumar vs State Of Karnataka
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: We are well conversant with the facts of the above application.
Hence, we are swearing to this joint affidavit.
2. The averments made in the accompanying joint memo from paras 1 to 2 for settlement and to quash the proceedings are true and correct to the best of our knowledge, information and belief.

3. We submit that both of us have decided to put an end to litigation/proceedings in investigation in (Crime No.19/2025 Shimogga Rural Police Station) for the offences punishable under Section 506, 376 and 417 of IPC pending in the Court of the JMFC III Court Shimogga, produced at Annexure-A and B, in the interest of the parties and due to the mutually agreed to compromise the issue and the Respondent No.2 and Petitioners have wilfully agreed to withdraw the allegations made against each other without there being any force coercion and undue influence.
4.

In view of this Petitioner and Respondent No.2 humbly pray that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to quash the FIR investigation in (Crime No.19/2025 Shimogga Rural Police Station) for the offences punishable under Section NC: 2025:KHC:18730 HC-KAR 506, 376 and 417 of IPC pending in the court of the JMFC III Court Shimogga, produced at Annexure-A and B, in the ends of justice.

entities.text: Crime No.19/2025 Shimogga Rural Police Station
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
What is stated above are all true and correct to the best of our knowledge, belief and information."
4.

In view of the aforesaid settlement entered into between the petitioner and respondent No.2, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) The petition is disposed of in terms of Joint Affidavit dated 22.05.2025.

(ii) The proceedings in Crime No.19/2025 registered by respondent No.1 - Police, for the offences punishable under Sections 506, 376 and 417 of IPC, pending on the file of JMFC III Court, Shimogga, insofar as the petitioner is concerned, are hereby quashed.

Sd/-
